# qrc-gen

> Free QR code generator at https://qr.donotpanic.space. No accounts, no tracking. Runs fully in the browser.

## Pages
- [English](https://qr.donotpanic.space/en): generator UI in English
- [Slovenščina](https://qr.donotpanic.space/sl): generator UI in Slovenian

## Features
- Content types: URL or text, Wi-Fi network, vCard contact
- Styles: colors, dot shapes, corner styles, quiet-zone padding, logo or text overlay
- Downloads: PNG and SVG

## Source
- [GitHub: DNP42/qrc-gen](https://github.com/DNP42/qrc-gen)
